problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 68 units
* Package Beta: size 42 units
* Package Gamma: size 65 units
* Package Delta: size 66 units
* Package Epsilon: size 63 units
* Package Zeta: size 70 units
* Package Eta: size 69 units
* Package Theta: size 57 units
* Package Iota: size 68 units
* Package Kappa: size 55 units
* Package Lambda: size 46 units
* Package Mu: size 60 units
* Package Nu: size 70 units
* Package Xi: size 70 units
* Package Omicron: size 68 units
* Package Pi: size 31 units
* Package Rho: size 52 units
* Package Sigma: size 52 units
* Package Tau: size 43 units
* Package Upsilon: size 32 units
* Package Phi: size 42 units
* Package Chi: size 58 units
* Package Psi: size 43 units
* Package Omega: size 63 units
* Package A1: size 43 units
* Package B1: size 30 units
* Package C1: size 39 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
